sex.evidence: Male WKY ... Female rats were excluded from this study

dosing.evidence: Each drug ... was dissolved in sterile saline and administered in a volume of 1 mL/kg intraperitoneally to each rat corresponding to their assigned treatment group (day 0) (PSI = 1.0 mg/kg)
Each drug ... was dissolved in sterile saline and administered in a volume of 1 mL/kg intraperitoneally ... (25CN-NBOH = 1.5 mg/kg)

group_housing.evidence: Rats were pair-housed with a standard 12:12 light-dark cycle

enrichment_housing.evidence: included Bed-r' Nest for enrichment (The Andersons, Inc., Maumee, Ohio)

assays.assay_description: 5-min swim in a cylindrical tank (114 cm × 30.5 cm, 30 cm water at 25-28°C) recorded for immobility, swimming, and climbing. 15-min pre-exposure on prior day (not recorded). Performed at 5 weeks (day 35) and 12 weeks (day 84) post drug.

application_type.evidence: administered in a volume of 1 mL/kg intraperitoneally

setup_habituation.evidence: A 15-min pre-exposure to the paradigm one day prior to testing is used to elicit consistent passive coping strategy

setup_restrain.evidence: rats were placed into a plastic cylindrical tank ... could swim freely

food_restriction.evidence: No food was present in the tank during testing

water_restriction.evidence: Tank contained water for swimming only, not for drinking

time_to_assay.evidence: Rats were evaluated in the FST 35 days (5 weeks) and 84 days (12 weeks) after a single administration

sample_size.evidence: Each treatment group had eight animals per group (n = 8)

outcomes.summary: Both psilocybin (1.0 mg/kg) and 25CN-NBOH (1.5 mg/kg) significantly reduced immobility and increased swimming compared with saline at both 5 and 12 weeks post-administration, with no loss of effect size over time. Climbing was unaffected. 25CN-NBOH produced larger effects than psilocybin.
outcomes.statistics: Immobility: treatment F(2,21)=20.28, p<0.0001; PSI vs SAL p=0.0077 (5wk), p=0.0032 (12wk); 25CN-NBOH vs SAL p<0.0001 at both; 25CN-NBOH vs PSI p=0.0290 (5wk), p=0.0257 (12wk). Swimming: F(2,21)=22.92, p<0.0001.
outcomes.evidence: Rats given PSI were significantly less immobile than control rats at 5 weeks (p = 0.0077) and 12 weeks (p = 0.0032) ... No differences were observed within individual treatment groups between 5- and 12-week time points

B1_num_measures.evidence: scored for immobility, swimming, and climbing

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total counts reported for the 5-min session; no within-session time course

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No transitions or behavioural sequences analysed

B4_ethological.evidence: Immobility, swimming, climbing are FST coping measures, not natural ethological behaviours

B5_social.evidence: Each rat tested alone in tank

B6_cognitive.evidence: FST does not require learning or memory

B7_automated_classification.evidence: FST scoring was performed by trained scorers blind to the treatment conditions

B8_multivariate.evidence: Repeated measures ANOVA on individual measures

E7_social_context.evidence: rats were placed individually into tank

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or drinkable water in apparatus

D1_continuity.evidence: FST performed at days 35 and 84 post-administration

D2_session_duration.evidence: the rats were exposed to a 5-min swim

D3_recording_days.evidence: evaluated in the FST 35 days and 84 days

assays.assay_description: 5-min open field exploration in a 61 cm² arena with 45 cm opaque walls. Distance traveled tracked by EthoVision XT 8.5. Performed immediately prior to FST at 5 and 12 weeks post-drug.

application_type.evidence: administered in a volume of 1 mL/kg intraperitoneally

setup_habituation.evidence: No prior habituation to the LCA arena described

setup_restrain.evidence: allowing them to explore freely for 5 min

food_restriction.evidence: No food present in arena during 5-min test

water_restriction.evidence: No water present in arena during 5-min test

time_to_assay.evidence: Locomotor activity was also measured immediately prior to FST testing at weeks 5 and 12

sample_size.evidence: Equipment failure resulted in the exclusion of four videos of LCA from Week 5 - one from the control group, one from the PSI group, and two from the 25CN-NBOH group

outcomes.summary: Locomotor activity (distance traveled) did not differ between psilocybin, 25CN-NBOH, and saline groups at either 5 or 12 weeks post-administration, ruling out nonspecific sedative/stimulant confounds on FST.
outcomes.statistics: Mixed-effects analysis (REML); no significant differences reported.
outcomes.evidence: No significant differences were observed between treatment groups

B4_ethological.evidence: Locomotor distance is not an ethological behaviour

B7_automated_classification.evidence: EthoVision XT 8.5 tracking software (position tracking only)

E1_environment_type.evidence: open field square arena (61 cm²) with 45 cm opaque walls

E3_bedding.evidence: Standard open field, no bedding described

E7_social_context.evidence: placing each rat into the arena

E8_food_water.evidence: No food/water in apparatus during 5-min test

D1_continuity.evidence: measured immediately prior to FST testing at weeks 5 and 12

D2_session_duration.evidence: allowing them to explore freely for 5 min

judge_notes: All three candidates agreed on two behavioural assays: FST and Locomotor Activity (open field). No assay merging was required beyond that.
Excluded slice electrophysiology, spine counting/microscopy, and qRT-PCR per rubric (non-behavioural endpoints).
Age: rated young_adult (PND 50-55 is at the boundary; majority of candidates went adolescent vs young_adult — chose young_adult since PND 50+ rats are typically considered young adult).
time_to_assay: scored as 'multiple' (50400 min ≈ 35 days to first session; 84 days to second) — corrected gptoss which scored early_2to24h.
Setup_habituation for FST: scored 'yes' because the 15-min pre-exposure trial (no data recorded) constitutes habituation to the apparatus.
